message.reasoning:
We need to produce a test class for JsonSchema.findAncestor(). Should include setup, mocking dependencies. Need to test behavior: when parent schema is null, returns itself; when parent exists, recursively returns top ancestor.

We need to create JsonSchema instances. Constructor is private, but there is static factory method from(...). We can use JsonSchema.from(...). Need ValidationContext, JsonNode schemaNode, etc. We can mock ValidationContext and JsonNode to simplify. Since from is static, we can call it with mocks.

We need to set up a parent chain: child schema with parent mock, etc. Use Mockito to mock getParentSchema() behavior? Actually JsonSchema extends BaseJsonValidator which likely has getParentSchema() method. But we can create JsonSchema objects using from, providing parent parameter.

We can create a mock ValidationContext, mock JsonNode, and use dummy URI, schemaPath string.

Construct parent schema: JsonSchema parent = JsonSchema.from(validationContext, "parentPath", URI.create("http://example.com/parent"), schemaNode, null, false);

Then child: JsonSchema child = JsonSchema.from(validationContext, "childPath", URI.create("http://example.com/child"), schemaNode, parent, false);

Now test findAncestor: child.findAncestor() should return parent (since parent has no parent). Actually parent.findAncestor() returns itself because its parent is null. So child.findAncestor() returns parent.

Also test top-level: parent.findAncestor() returns parent.

Also test deeper chain: grandchild with parent child, should return topmost parent.

Edge case: when getParentSchema() returns null (top). Already covered.

We need to mock ValidationContext methods used in JsonSchema.from: getMetaSchema(), getConfig() etc. Provide default behavior to avoid NPE. Use Mockito to stub getMetaSchema() returning mock(JsonMetaSchema.class). getConfig() maybe null, that's okay.

Also need to stub getURIFactory, etc? Not used in from maybe.

But JsonSchema.from may call other methods that rely on ValidationContext, but we can keep config null to avoid keywordWalkListenerRunner init.

Thus in setupBeforeEach we create mocks and instances.

Write tests using @Test methods.

Add necessary imports: java.net.URI, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode.

Now produce final code block.
